statement_en:
Let the \(N(s)\) positive roots of \(\cos(x)=sx\) be ordered as
\\[
x_1(s)<x_2(s)<\\cdots<x_{N(s)}(s).
\\]
Then:
1. \(N(s)\\sim \\frac{1}{\\pi s}\).
2. For every \(1\\leq k\\leq N(s)\),
\\[
k\\pi<x_k(s)<(k+1)\\pi.
\\]
